San Francisco · 2026 to 2028

Street sweeping holidays.

The days San Francisco does not enforce daytime street sweeping, every date through New Year's Day 2029. From SFMTA's holiday enforcement schedule.

Next sweeping holiday

What it means

Daytime off, nights mostly on

Daytime sweeping is off

On every date below, San Francisco does not enforce daytime street sweeping. The sweep isn't moved to another day: your block's next regular sweep still applies.

Night routes keep going

Blocks swept overnight and the 7-day commercial routes still sweep on most holidays. They stop only on New Year's Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas. Your block's hours on the map show which kind it is.

The sign wins

The posted sign is always the source of truth. If a sign on your block says something else, follow the sign.

Every date

The full list

The 2026 dates are SFMTA's posted schedule. Dates in 2027 and 2028 follow SFMTA's rule and will be re-checked when SFMTA posts them. Source: SFMTA's holiday enforcement schedule.
